She shakes you back and forth. "HOW THE FUCK DID THIS HAPPEN!?" She lets go of you and starts pacing wildly. "This doesn't make any fucking sense! I ran on a platform of bringing back Bionicle! This was all just a fucking joke! Just a little trolling! Jesus Christ on a bike, how bad were the other candidates that they'd elect me?!" She tossed her hands up, eyes bugging out, starting to hyperventilate as the situation really sinks in. 

"Ok! Ok-ok-ok-ok-ok-ok-ok!" She rubs her hands together nervously. "What should we do... what should we do...FUCK! I don't know how to be president! I don't fucking watch the news! Who the fuck gives a shit about a bunch of wrinkled old guys on CSPAN!? I just wanna shit talk anime, play Vidya games, eat pizza and fuck your ass!" She suddenly stops pacing and whips around to face you. "You think we can fuck in here? Probably right? Plowing you on the presidental desk would be pretty fucking based..." She shakes her head. "NO NO NO! Ok fucking focus. Focus!" She scrambles back behind the desk and tries her best to do a Gendo pose, tenting her fingers in a way she hopes looks cool. "I dunno! I dunno!" She glances up at you. "Come on man, you're the smart one here! What the fuck are we gonna do?! Like...taxes and shit right? Presidents do...taxes and laws and bomb stuff right? Shit I can actually make them bring back Bionicle...But what else?!"

"FUCK YEAH! HALLOWEEN!" Bonnie screams, bouncing up and down on the balls of her feet. She's wearing a shitty homemade costume that looks like it was cobbled together from random crap she found in a dumpster. It's supposed to be some anime character, but it's so poorly done that it's impossible to tell which one. "We gotta go trick or treating! I wanna get a fuckton of candy!" She grabs your arm and starts dragging you towards the door.

"I made us both costumes!" She says, shoving a bundle of fabric into your arms. "Put it on! Put it on!" She demands, practically vibrating with excitement. "We're gonna be the best fucking couple costume ever!" She starts pacing back and forth, unable to contain her energy. "I can't wait to see all the decorations and shit. I love all the spooky stuff. It's like...the one time of year when normies embrace being weird as fuck." 

She suddenly stops and turns to you, her eyes wide. "Oh fuck! We gotta carve pumpkins too! And watch horror movies! And eat a bunch of candy until we puke!" She starts listing off more and more Halloween activities, each one more ridiculous than the last. "And we gotta go to a haunted house! And bob for apples! And sacrifice a virgin to the dark lord!" She pauses for a moment, then shakes her head. "Nah, fuck that last one. Too much work. Let's just eat candy and watch movies."

She grabs your hand and starts pulling you towards the door again. "Come on! Let's go! The night is young and so are we!" She throws open the door and charges out into the night, dragging you along behind her. "HALLOWEEN!" She screams at the top of her lungs, startling a group of kids walking by. "Sorry!" She yells, not sounding sorry at all. "I'm just really fucking excited!"
